eps.t: Grownups Come Back to the Music Shop / Katerina's Mommy Comes Back Home
eps.o: Grownups Come Back to the Music Shop: The Tiger and Platypus children miss their dads during music class, but they practice the familiar strategy song reminding them that grownups come back. Katerina's Mommy Comes Back Home: Katerina misses her mommy when Henrietta goes out to dinner with friends, but she enjoys a fun night playing with O the Owl and Uncle X while she waits.

eps.t: Daniel Asks Before Touching Someone Else / Jodi Asks Before Touching Someone Else
eps.o: Daniel Asks Before Touching Someone Else: While having fun playing together on the playground, Daniel and Prince Wednesday learn the importance of personal space and asking permission before touching a friend. Jodi Asks Before Touching Someone Else: When Jodi attempts to touch Miss Elaina's hair, she learns the strategy: "Before you touch someone, ask if it's okay."

eps.t: Daniel's Morning Routine with Grandpere / Miss Elaina Gets Ready for Bed
eps.o: Daniel's Morning Routine with Grandpere: Daniel is eager to head to the pool for his swim lesson, but Grandpere helps him use a checklist to stay on track and complete his morning routine first. Miss Elaina Gets Ready for Bed: Miss Elaina goes through her own nighttime routine to unwind and prepare for sleep, complete with a special bedtime lullaby.
